title: Synthesis, characterization, and in vitro and in silico α-glucosidase inhibitory evolution of novel N′-(2-cyclopentyl-2-phenylacetyl)cinnamohydrazide derivatives
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,17118-17129
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA01971K, Paper
Open Access

Ram Reddy Mudireddy, Rambabu Gundla, Baji Baba Shaik, Anoop Bodapati, Panasa Mahesh, Shiva Sravan Naidu, Damodar Tirumalasetti, Naresh Kumar Katari
To discover potential α-glucosidase inhibitory agents, a new series of N′-(2-cyclopentyl-2-phenylacetyl)cinnamohydrazide derivatives were designed and synthesized as α-glucosidase inhibitors.
